news.title: Johnson Pharmacare Limited Appoints Parul Agrawal as an Additional Non-Executive & Independent Director of the Company, Effective February 13, 2026
news.body: Johnson Pharmacare Limited, at its board meeting held on 13 February, 2026, appointed Parul Agrawal as an Additional Non-Executive & Independent Director of the Company with effect from 13th February, 2026. Date of birth is July 21, 1986.

news.title: Johnson Pharmacare Limited to Report Q3, 2026 Results on Feb 12, 2026
news.body: Johnson Pharmacare Limited announced that they will report Q3, 2026 results on Feb 12, 2026

news.title: Johnson Pharmacare Limited Announces Resignation of Babita as Non-Executive & Independent Director, Effective 24 January 2026
news.body: Johnson Pharmacare Limited announced that there is a Change in Directors of Board Ms. Babita, Non-Executive & Independent Director of the Company has resigned from the Board with effect from 24 January, 2026 on account of personal reasons and unavoidable reason.

news.title: Johnson Pharmacare Limited Appoints Rajender Parsad as an Additional & Non- Executive Director, Effective 24 January 2026
news.body: Johnson Pharmacare Limited at its board of directors meeting held on January 24, 2026, the Board has appointed Mr. Rajender Parsad as an Additional & Non- Executive Director of the Company with effect from 24 January 2026. Date of birth: October 1, 1969. Education qualification: Graduate.

news.title: Johnson Pharmacare Limited Announces Resignation of Directors from Board, Effective from 21 January, 2026
news.body: Johnson Pharmacare Limited announced that there is a Change in Directors of Board Mr. Rajender Parsad (DIN: 10871533) Additional & Non-Executive Director of the Company has resigned from the Board w.e.f. 21st January, 2026 on account of personal reasons and unavoidable reason and also there is a Change in Directors of Board Ms. Parul Agrawal (DIN: 11268580) Additional Non-Executive & Independent Director of the Company has resigned from the Board w.e.f. 21 January, 2026 on account of personal reasons and unavoidable reason.
